caseName: Machinists Non-Partisan Political League v. Federal Election Commission
caseNameFull: Machinists Non-Partisan Political League v. Federal Election Commission

opinions.text: Application for stay of execution and enforcement of the order of the United States District Court for the District of Columbia, entered January 30, 1980, presented to The Chief Justice, and by him referred to the Court, denied. The order entered by The Chief Justice on May 23,1980, is vacated.
